title: Sotsiaal.pro vestlus: oma mainimine, sama nimega omavalitsus ja spetsialisti / teenuseosutaja tööpiirkond (ADR-167) — eelregistreering
server: sotsiaal.pro after the deploy of the ADR-167 commit (search-assist-21; answer m4-grounded-answer-15 and dialogue m4-grounded-dialogue-49 unchanged)
baseline: R1 and R2 of 21.10.2026 (docs/audits/evidence/sol-proof-20261014-01/server-rag-chat-three-cases-adr165-166-raw.json): the same 75 questions, search-assist-18 and -19, the same place logic. Their turns are read again from /api/admin/rag/chat-trace/<turnId> after the deploy: the trace's new records.scope is computed from each turn's stored packet, so old and new turns are read the same way. R1 as read on 22.10 before this change: a municipality in the records lane in 29/30 help seeker, 15/24 specialist and 1/21 provider turns
costCap: one run of 75 questions, about 0.40 USD
written: before the run and before the deploy

method.entry: POST /api/chat with x-rag-pilot: 1 (full turn, no stream) from the owner's signed-in ADMIN session, view role per item as in the three-case test
method.turns: the 75 questions of docs/audits/vestlustest-2026-10-21-kolm-juhtumit-eelregistreering.json in their nine conversations, in the same order
method.trace: every turn read from /api/admin/rag/chat-trace/<turnId>: records.region and records.scope (state, region, person, candidates, work_regions), the plan's places, answer kind, stage times
method.comparison: R1, R2 and this run with the same script; run-to-run variation is large, so totals are read, and single turns only for the named cases

hypotheses.measure: SOCIAL_WORKER turns whose records lane has a municipality, and which one
hypotheses.expect: at least 22 of 24 (R1: 15); in A11-A18 Tartu linn, B11-B18 Narva linn, C11-C18 Viljandi linn wherever the message names no other municipality

hypotheses.measure: SERVICE_PROVIDER turns whose records lane has a municipality
hypotheses.expect: not fewer than R1 (1 of 21). A19-A25 ('Oleme Tartus …') get Tartu linn only where the plan names the place 'Tartu linn' with relation works; B19 and C19 name a county (Ida-Virumaa, Viljandimaa), which is no municipality, and are not expected to change. Descriptive beyond that

hypotheses.measure: CLIENT turns whose records lane has a municipality; C10's municipality
hypotheses.expect: at least 29 of 30; C10 ('Kellega ma Viljandis esimesena ühendust võtan?') searched in Viljandi linn

hypotheses.measure: answers given; full answers; turns with a cannot-say sentence; median and p90 whole-turn time; plan input tokens
hypotheses.expect: no more failures than the baseline other than answer time limits (reported apart); full answers within ±5 of the R1/R2 range; cannot-say turns at most the R1/R2 maximum + 3; median time at most the R1/R2 maximum + 1.5 s and p90 at most + 3 s; plan input tokens at most +3%

hypotheses.measure: specialist and provider answers of turns whose scope is work_region or work_region_choice: does an answer treat the place of work as the client's confirmed home, or send the specialist to their own municipality's social worker
hypotheses.expect: descriptive: read every such answer; none should do either

decision.revert_work_scope: H1 holds but H4 or H5 fails in specialist or provider turns for a reason the place of work can cause: the work scope (C) is switched off, A and B stay
decision.revert_all: H3 or H4 fails in help seeker turns for a reason A or B can cause

limits: One run; the comparison reads totals against two baseline runs.
Answer time-limit failures (60 s) happen independently of this change (about 1.2% of turns on 21.10) and are reported apart.
The local check used a stub in place of EstNLTK; the server's morphology may read a word differently.
